_comment: Exact per-iteration allocation budgets in bytes (GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread, Release). Zero-alloc paths use bytesPerIteration 0. String-library scenarios budget the single result allocation: resultLength is the result's byte length (a Lua string is one byte[] with an 8-byte header, so the result costs 24 + round8(8 + resultLength) bytes). excessBytes records allocation beyond that single result; it is 0 everywhere (spec ticket 17 decision 3) and raising it needs a PR citing before/after numbers; CODEOWNERS enforces.
